title: UPI — 중국 외교부, 트럼프-시진핑 회담에서 북핵 논의 확인하면서도 '비핵화' 표현 명시적 사용 회피
snippet: China's Foreign Ministry officially confirmed North Korea-related nuclear issues were discussed during the Xi-Trump summit, while avoiding direct use of the phrase 'North Korea denuclearization.' Analysts said the wording reflected Beijing's effort to avoid friction with Kim Jong Un while maintaining diplomatic flexibility with Washington. It remains unclear whether China's agreement would translate into greater pressure on NK, given Beijing's lackluster enforcement of sanctions.
tag_reason: 중국의 공식 반응(5/19)은 이전 7일 소스에 포함되지 않은 신규 발전. 미국과 중국 간 '비핵화' 표현 차이라는 중요한 외교적 뉘앙스를 담은 신규 분석.
